proposals.title: Improve shareholder written consent
proposals.topic_summary: Enable 10% of shares to request a record date to initiate written consent, rather than 27%, and reduce supermajority barriers to shareholder action outside meetings.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Racial equity audit and report
proposals.topic_summary: Oversee a racial equity audit of JPMorgan's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in for the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Political and electioneering expenditure congruency report
proposals.proponent: Rhia Ventures on behalf of Jonathan Weinstock
proposals.topic_summary: Publish an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures are congruent with publicly stated company values and policies, including reputational risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
